name: Abstract
description: Photos built around pattern, texture, line or repetition rather than a recognizable scene.

name: Landscape
description: Wide views of natural or open scenery, such as deserts, seas, lakes and mountains.

name: Nature
description: Close looks at the natural world, such as plants, fungi, moss and forest floors.

name: Portrait
description: Photos centered on a person, posed or candid, where the subject is the point of the picture.

name: Wildlife
description: Photos of animals, from birds in the city to creatures in the wild.
